sun.java2d

类 ScreenUpdateManager

  • java.lang.Object
    • sun.java2d.ScreenUpdateManager
  • 直接已知子类:
    D3DScreenUpdateManager

    public class ScreenUpdateManager
extends Object
    This class handles the creation of on-screen surfaces and corresponding graphics objects. By default it delegates the surface creation to the particular GraphicsConfiguration classes.

    • 方法详细资料

      • createGraphics

        public Graphics2D createGraphics(SurfaceData sd,
                                 WComponentPeer peer,
                                 Color fgColor,
                                 Color bgColor,
                                 Font font)
        Creates a SunGraphics2D object for the surface, given the parameters.
        参数:
        sd - surface data for which a graphics is to be created
        peer - peer which owns the surface
        fgColor - fg color to be used in the graphics
        bgColor - bg color to be used in the graphics
        font - font to be used in the graphics
        返回:
        a SunGraphics2D object for rendering to the passed surface

      • createScreenSurface

        public SurfaceData createScreenSurface(Win32GraphicsConfig gc,
                                       WComponentPeer peer,
                                       int bbNum,
                                       boolean isResize)
        Creates and returns the surface for the peer. This surface becomes managed by this manager. To remove the surface from the managed list dropScreenSurface(SurfaceData) will need to be called. The default implementation delegates surface creation to the passed in GraphicsConfiguration object.
        参数:
        gc - graphics configuration for which the surface is to be created
        peer - peer for which the onscreen surface is to be created
        bbNum - number of back-buffers requested for this peer
        isResize - whether this surface is being created in response to a component resize event
        返回:
        a SurfaceData to be used for on-screen rendering for this peer.
        另请参阅:
        dropScreenSurface(SurfaceData)

      • dropScreenSurface

        public void dropScreenSurface(SurfaceData sd)
        Drops the passed surface from the list of managed surfaces. Nothing happens if the surface wasn't managed by this manager.
        参数:
        sd - SurfaceData to be removed from the list of managed surfaces

      • getReplacementScreenSurface

        public SurfaceData getReplacementScreenSurface(WComponentPeer peer,
                                               SurfaceData oldsd)
        Returns a replacement SurfaceData for the invalid passed one. This method should be used by SurfaceData's created by the ScreenUpdateManager for providing replacement surfaces.
        参数:
        peer - to which the old surface belongs
        oldsd - the old (invalid) surface to get replaced
        返回:
        a replacement surface
        另请参阅:
        D3DSurfaceData.D3DWindowSurfaceData.getReplacement(), GDIWindowSurfaceData.getReplacement()

      • getInstance

        public static ScreenUpdateManager getInstance()
        Returns an (singleton) instance of the screen surfaces manager class.
        返回:
        instance of onscreen surfaces manager
